title: Roman Taxes and Tribute
lead: What Rome took from the lands it ruled, and what the Bible and Tacitus say about it: the registration under Quirinius (Luke 2:1-3), the head tax to Caesar (Matthew 22:17-21), the double drachma (Matthew 17:24-27), Paul's "If it is the tax, pay the tax" (Romans 13:7), and the rebel who called paying Rome cowardice (Josephus, War 2.8.1). After AD 70 the Jews' yearly two drachmas went to the Capitol (War 7.6.6).
